en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a residential district, characterized by mid-20th-century modernist apartment blocks surrounded by pine trees and natural landscapes. The buildings are simple, functional, and uniformly designed, suggesting a planned suburb or new town development. There is visible construction activity and several cleared plots, indicating expansion. The word 'RAKET' is visible on one of the buildings.
